subject: Request: prioritize CTO attendance for Redwood demo — propose consolidated slot
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora.p@brightwave.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning execs

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Quick note — our CTO Mark just changed travel plans and now has a 90-minute window on Mon 19 Jul (PDT) in the morning where he can join vendor demos. We were slated for the 22nd, but given some shifting priorities on our roadmap the exec presence on the 19th would be high priority for Brightwave.

Can Redwood consolidate the planned product + architecture walk-through into a single session early on the 19th so Mark can attend? If that requires shortening some sections or reordering, we can focus the agenda on integration points and latency/cost.

I attached the updated MVP requirements our engineering team will use in prep.

Thanks — Nora
Nora Patel
VP, Platform Engineering
Brightwave Analytics

Attachment: Brightwave_MVP_requirements.pdf (application/pdf, 1.1MB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.p@brightwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning execs

Nora — thanks for the heads up and the requirements doc. We can absolutely prioritize Mark's window.

Proposed approach: consolidate the session on Mon 19 Jul and run a 75-minute compressed demo: 30 min executive-level walkthrough (platform/value, cost/latency tradeoffs, deployment modes), 35 min technical deep-dive (integration hooks, live latency profile, token-cost examples), 10 min Q&A + next steps. That keeps it tight but covers the decision points you listed.

Options (PDT):
- Option A: 08:30–09:45 (fits Mark's earliest window)
- Option B: 10:00–11:15 (if a slightly later slot works better)

If either works, I'll send a consolidated invite and loop Marissa from Solutions so we can show the integration diagram and a quick config demo. I also attached our latest mutual action plan so Brightwave has the proposed milestones if we move forward.

If you need us to drop anything (e.g., remove the full KV cache demo) we can compress further to 50 minutes; tell me which areas are must-have.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 320KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.p@brightwave.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning execs

Thanks Vivek / Nora — quick note from my side: we can compress the technical deep-dive by focusing earliest on the three integration touchpoints you flagged (authentication/KMS, inference latency SLAs, and per-tenant routing). I can prepare a single slide with side-by-side configuration snippets that saves ~10 minutes.

If Mark can only do 60 minutes total, target 08:30–09:30 and we'll prioritize exec+integration + 15 min Q&A.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

(One-line) I'll join the call and run the integration snippets live so no additional prep needed on your side.

From: Nora Patel <nora.p@brightwave.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning execs

Vivek / Laura — confirmed: Mark can join 08:30–09:30 on Mon 19 Jul. He also asked whether our VP of Product (Elena Rios) can dial in for the first 20 minutes.

Please go ahead and send the updated invite and include the agenda at the top. Also, could you add the HubSpot meeting record and the mutual action plan link to the invite so our procurement team has the materials?

Appreciate the flexibility — Nora
